metadata.name: freightchain_pools
metadata.description: Escrowed prize pools: assurance-contract tickets, trustless refunds, public split

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Pays the ticket price. May be the same key as `fee_payer`.

accounts.name: fee_payer
docs: Pays the transaction fee and the Ticket rent (recorded as `rent_payer`). The sponsor when gasless.

accounts.name: caller
docs: `config.authority` / `config.payout_authority` from `payout_at`; anyone after the settle grace; anyone for a fully refunded pool.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone: the exit when the admin never settles.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone: a permissionless crank.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone (the server's crank in practice): pays the Pool account rent and the vault rent minimum, which comes back at close.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `config.authority` or `config.payout_authority`

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can crank refunds (the fee payer of the transaction).

accounts.name: ticket
docs: must give the readable `AlreadyRefunded`, not an Anchor deserialization error.

errors.name: BpsSum
errors.msg: Prize, seed and fee shares must sum to 10000 bps

errors.name: PriceBelowRentMin
errors.msg: Ticket price is below the rent-exempt minimum

errors.name: TreasuryNotRentExempt
errors.msg: A treasury account is not rent-exempt yet

errors.name: PoolNotOpen
errors.msg: Pool is not open for tickets

errors.name: SoldOut
errors.msg: Not enough tickets left in the pool

errors.name: NotFailable
errors.msg: Pool cannot be failed (not Open, deadline not passed, or minimum reached)

errors.name: PrizeExceedsShare
errors.msg: Prize payments would exceed the pool's prize share

errors.name: BelowRentMin
errors.msg: Transfer would leave an account below the rent-exempt minimum

errors.name: AccountMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not match the recorded one

errors.name: PrizesAlreadyPaid
errors.msg: Prizes were already paid from this pool

errors.name: MustExpire
errors.msg: No prize was paid: an unsettled pool must be expired and refunded, not closed

errors.name: SeriesDisabled
errors.msg: This pool series is switched off

fields.name: platform_fee_bps
docs: Share of the FEE share (not of the pool) that goes to `platform_treasury` at close.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Two-step authority handover: set by `propose_authority`, consumed by `accept_authority`.

fields.name: payout_authority
docs: May pay prizes and close a pool once its `payout_at` has come (the server's payout key) – nothing else. None = only `authority`.

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: prep_deadline
docs: end of the sale window: no ticket is sold from here on; under the minimum the pool can only fail (refunds)

fields.name: play_deadline
docs: rides count until here

fields.name: payout_at
docs: end of the review window: prizes and the close only from here on

fields.name: authority
docs: Creator record (receives the vault rent minimum at close). Admin rights come from `Config.authority`.

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: payout_at
docs: end of the review window: no prize is paid and the pool is not closed before it

fields.name: prize_paid
docs: prizes paid out over the pool's life

fields.name: seed
docs: everything that went to seed_treasury (seed share + unclaimed prize [+ donations / sponsorship of a failed pool])

fields.name: fee
docs: fee share that went to fee_treasury (after the platform cut)

fields.name: rent_returned
docs: vault rent minimum returned to the authority

fields.name: from_series
docs: true = opened by `open_next_pool` from the tier's series, false = `create_pool` by the admin

types.name: Series
docs: One schedule per tier, written by the admin (`set_series`): every pool `open_next_pool` creates takes these rules. Pools tile time:
the next one opens when this one stops selling (`next_open_at`), so a 24 h sale window = one pool a day.

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: sale_secs
docs: sale window = cadence (seconds)

fields.name: play_secs
docs: after the sale ends, rides of the pool still count this long

fields.name: verify_secs
docs: after the play deadline: the review window before any prize is paid

fields.name: next_open_at
docs: the start of the next sale slot; `open_next_pool` is refused before it

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: sale_secs
docs: sale window AND cadence: the next pool opens when this one stops selling

fields.name: play_secs
docs: rides still count this long after the sale ends

fields.name: verify_secs
docs: review window after the play deadline, before any prize

fields.name: start_at
docs: the first sale slot starts here; 0 = keep the series' current `next_open_at` (refused for a new series)
